disambiguation: Not an in-app AI chat plugin; it runs real command-line coding agents in a terminal panel.
extras: Downloads a node-pty native module from GitHub releases on first terminal use (with permission and SHA-256 check); warns that permission-skipping commands and agents run with the user's full file permissions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal and no way to launch command-line AI coding agents against a vault or keep their separate instruction files in sync.
